summary: On paper Buffalo has the edge (Buffalo ranks 1st in EPA per dropback, +0.34), while Las Vegas's best counter is to win up front (Las Vegas' defense ranks 2nd in pressure rate, 27% generated). Under center, Josh Allen ranks 1st of 23 in EPA per dropback and Kirk Cousins ranks 4th; x-factor: James Cook gains +0.9 rushing yards over expected per carry, 7th of 27, and Las Vegas' run defense ranks 12th. The model favors Buffalo at 67%, mostly on rushing matchup (4.1 pts) and passing matchup (1.9 pts).
